entities.summary: Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye is a Ghanaian politician and a former member of the Seventh and Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana. He represented the Biakoye Constituency in the Oti Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress. In April 2022, he organized a free eye screening and surgery for the residents of Biakoye.
